method_notes: Straight-line distance from the location of the home property to the central point of the school site, as determined by Wandsworth Council's Geographical Information System; measurements by other systems/to other points not accepted; ties broken at random (Wandsworth community school admissions policies, Note 4/5). The 'Choose a Wandsworth Primary School' brochure (Sept 2027 entry) says distance is measured in a straight line between home and the centre of the school site, with all measurements calculated by the council GIS. Exceptions: Belleville Primary distances measured to its main Webb's Road site; priority areas used by Beatrix Potter, Furzedown, Penwortham, Sellincourt, Franciscan and St Michael's CE; faith schools apply faith/parish criteria before distance. All figures are 'furthest distance offered' on national offer day (16 April), in metres.

gaps: PAN is null for schools where every applicant was offered (the docs give no figures for those rows). Postcodes for open schools come from the council brochure; GIAS was not checked. Honeywell Junior School omitted (not a Reception entry point). Broadwater Primary closed Aug 2024 and does not appear in any of the three docs. Some PDF tables were garbled when extracted: Belleville Wix class/column mapping, St Faith's and St Mary's Putney column mapping, and Gatton 2024 criterion are lower-confidence; Penwortham 2024 printed as '491mm'. Faith schools in some years publish only category counts with no distance (status not_published). Academy/free school/VA policies were not individually checked for measurement method; the council brochure says all distances are calculated by the council GIS, so straight_line is assumed for all. The 2026 'apply for a primary school place 2026' PDF could not be fetched.
